summary: Phase 2-4 Estimate Workbench frontend testing PASSED on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 11 review-request features verified: 3-panel desktop layout renders (Library Browser + Estimate Builder + Live Summary), Library shows 24 domains from Production Library, clicking standards adds them to Estimate (with click-to-increment), multi-item grouping by domain with subtotals works, Live Summary shows item count/subtotal/tax(13%)/total in real time, mobile view auto-switches at <1024px and shows a + button that opens a full-screen library modal with Back + Done Adding footer, PDF export triggers jsPDF download on both desktop and mobile (verified filename 'New Estimate_2026-07-14.pdf' downloaded), inline edit updates qty/price (5 x $100 -> $500 subtotal + $65 tax = $565 total confirmed), Remove item works (3 -> 2 items), Clear estimate resets to empty state after confirm dialog.

ui_bugs.issue: Tax label is hardcoded as 'Tax (13%)' instead of interpolating the taxRate prop (as done on desktop LiveSummary). If taxRate ever changes it will render incorrectly on mobile.

Mobile view shows static title 'Estimate Builder' and does not expose the estimate-name input, whereas the desktop header allows renaming the estimate via [data-testid="estimate-name-input"]. Mobile users cannot rename their estimate.

The button label 'Done Adding (N items)' occasionally lags one render behind (showed '(0 items)' immediately after adding one item; count updates on next render). Minor visual glitch — data is correct.

Inline edit Save/Cancel buttons have no data-testid. Header 'Save' button also has text 'Save' which caused ambiguous selectors. Add e.g. data-testid="edit-save-btn"/"edit-cancel-btn" for reliable automated testing.

Direct-standard rows (rendered when a standard has no service_category_ids) have NO data-testid, unlike category standards which have [data-testid="library-item-${id}"]. This creates inconsistent selectors for tests. Also observed grouping duplication: 'Multi-Family' and 'Multifamily' appear as two separate domain folders — likely seed-data hygiene, not code.

integration_issues.issue: Pre-existing console errors persist since iteration_26: '[AppLayout] Workspace context error: TypeError: Failed to fetch', '[useOrganization] Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch', '[CommandCenter] Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch'. These do NOT affect the Estimate Workbench (library API succeeds and returns 24 domains + 114 items). Unchanged carry-over — not a Phase 2-4 regression.

issues: All seeded standards have $0.00 unit prices (as noted in review request) — visually the Estimate list is dominated by '1 × $0.00 = $0.00' rows and the Summary shows Total $0.00 unless the user manually edits prices. Once edited, calcs are correct (verified $500 subtotal → $565 total). Consider adding a subtle placeholder/hint on rows with zero price prompting the user to click Edit.

Save button in the top header (data-testid=save-estimate-btn) currently only fires toast.info('Save functionality coming soon') — feature is intentionally not implemented (Phase 4 backend snapshot save not wired). Button should either be disabled, hidden, or labelled 'Coming soon' to avoid user confusion.
'Send to Client' button in LiveSummary also only fires toast.info('Send to client coming soon') — same UX gap.
Seeded domain list contains both 'Multi-Family' and 'Multifamily' — appears to be a data-hygiene duplicate that should be de-duplicated at the seed level.

action_items: MEDIUM: Expose the estimate-name input in MobileWorkbench so mobile users can rename the estimate (currently static 'Estimate Builder' string).
MEDIUM: Wire the top-right 'Save' button to the real backend (or disable/hide/label 'Coming soon') — currently only fires an info toast.
MEDIUM: Wire 'Send to Client' button (same as above).
LOW: MobileWorkbench.jsx line 110 — interpolate taxRate instead of hardcoded 'Tax (13%)'.
LOW: Add data-testid to inline edit Save/Cancel buttons in EstimateBuilder to disambiguate from header Save button.
LOW: Add data-testid to LibraryBrowser directStandards rows (currently only nested-category standards have library-item-${id} testid).
LOW: De-duplicate 'Multi-Family' vs 'Multifamily' at the seed data level.
LOW/CARRY-OVER: Pre-existing [AppLayout]/useOrganization/[CommandCenter] 'Failed to fetch' console errors persist since iteration_26 — unrelated to Phase 2-4.
critical_code_review_comments: EstimateWorkbench.jsx: `calculations` are recomputed both in EstimateWorkbench.jsx and again in LiveSummary.jsx (identical useMemo). LiveSummary should accept `calculations` as a prop from the parent (which is already passed to MobileWorkbench) to keep a single source of truth and avoid drift.

EstimateWorkbench.jsx handleClearEstimate uses window.confirm — for a modern SPA prefer the existing shadcn AlertDialog / sonner-style confirmation to match the rest of the app UI (also blocks playwright unless a dialog handler is registered).

EstimateWorkbench.jsx line 231-234: `handleSendToClient` and the header Save both only toast 'coming soon'. Ship these behind a feature flag or hide the buttons entirely to avoid user confusion — currently they look active but do nothing.

EstimateBuilder.jsx: onReorderItems prop is passed but no drag-and-drop wire-up implemented (GripVertical is decorative only). Either remove the drag handle or wire up a DnD library (e.g., @dnd-kit) to fulfil the 'drag-and-drop reordering' comment in the file header.

LibraryBrowser.jsx directStandards render block (lines 293-315) is a near-duplicate of the category-standards render block (lines 260-285). Extract a shared <StandardRow /> subcomponent with a data-testid so both branches remain in sync and testable.

estimatePdfGenerator.js line 399: footer prints 'Page 1 of N' on every page — page number is hard-coded to '1'. On multi-page estimates each page will incorrectly say 'Page 1 of 3'. Iterate over doc.getNumberOfPages() and setPage(i) to stamp each page's real number.
MobileWorkbench.jsx line 110: hardcoded 'Tax (13%)' — should interpolate the taxRate prop like LiveSummary does.
MobileWorkbench.jsx does not expose the estimate-name input, taxRate/markup controls, or the Clear button — mobile users can add items and export PDF but cannot rename or reconfigure the estimate.

EstimateWorkbench.jsx state (lineItems, estimateName, tax, markup) is purely local — a page refresh loses the estimate entirely. Backend snapshot save (Phase 4) is not yet wired; document this as WIP in the UI so users don't lose work.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing production library — 24 domains / 114 standards, all with $0 prices as noted).
